### 融合多屏反控类设计
（1）窗口管理类，用于处理窗口事件和进行坐标变换
```cpp
//也可使用社区窗口类wm_common.h的类似定义
struct Point {
	uint32_t posX = 0;
	uint32_t posY = 0;
}

struct Rect {
	Point coord;
	uint32_t width = 0;
	uint32_t height = 0;

	Rect();
	Rect(uint32_t posX, uint32_t posY, uint32_t width, uint32_t height);
    bool isInside(Point point)
    {
        if(point.posX < coord.posX || point.posX > (coord.posX + width))
            return false;
        if(point.posY < coord.posY || point.posY > (coord.posY + height))
            return false;

        return true;       
    }
};

//改名
enum CanvasControllerType : int32_t {
	//Source Window 监听窗口事件和获取窗口位置大小功能
	SOURCE_WINDOW = 0x01,
	//Sink Window 监听窗口事件和获取窗口位置大小功能 + 远程窗口坐标变换功能
    SINK_WINDOW,
	//全屏未使用窗口，使用SCREEN/DISPLAY进行操作
	SOURCE_SCREEN,
	SINK_SCREEN,
};

class CanvasControllerListener {
	virtual void OnWindowChange(CanvasControllerType, Rect rect) = 0;
};

//一个Controller只有一个类型,区分Sink/Source,抽象一层
class CanvasController : public IWindowChangeListener
			  	   , public IWindowDragListener{
public:
	using Ptr = std::shared_ptr<CanvasController>;

	~CanvasController();
	CanvasController(CanvasControllerType type, uint64_t id);
	CanvasController(CanvasControllerType type, RectBox rect);
	
	void InitLocalCoordinate();
	void GetLocalCoordinate(Rect& localMmiRect, Rect& localVideoRect);
	void SetRemoteCoordinate(Rect remoteMmiRect, Rect remoteVideoRect);
	void GetRemoteCoordinate(Rect& remoteMmiRect, Rect& remoteVideoRect);

	bool IsEventInside();
	bool MapCoordinates(uint32_t &x, uint32_t &y); //改名

	int32_t Stop();
	int32_t Start();

	uint64_t GetCanvasId();
	CanvasControllerType GetCanvasType();

	//主控端/被控端窗口需要OnDrag/OnSizeChange作为修改位置/大小的参考
	void OnDrag(int32_t x, int32_t y, DragEvent event) override;
	void OnSizeChange(Rect rect, WindowSizeChangeReason reason) override;
	
private:
	void ConvertRelativeRect();
private:
	std::atomic<bool> start_;

	//本地ID
	uint64_t canvasId_ = 0;
	OHOS::Rosen::ScreenId screenId = SCREEN_ID_INVALID;
	//远程ID
	std::string devId = 0;
	std::string srcId = 0;

	//坐标变换独立封装和窗口管理类
	Rect relativeRect_ = {};
	Rect localMmiRect_ = {};
	Rect remoteMmiRect_ = {};
	Rect localVideoRect_ = {};
	Rect remoteVideoRect_ = {};

	sptr<OHOS::Rosen::Window> window_ = nullptr;
	sptr<OHOS::Rosen::Screen> screen_ = nullptr;
	sptr<OHOS::Rosen::Display> display_ = nullptr;
	std::weak_ptr<CanvasControllerListener> listener = nullptr;

	CanvasControllerType canvasType_;
};
```
（2）多模事件采集端/处理端 （MMISink/MMISource）
Source/sink均为OHOS的多模输入客户端，依赖位置：
//foundation/multimodalinput/input/frameworks/proxy:libmmi-client
```cpp
class InputBackControllerListener {
	virtual void OnMmiControllerNotify(MMIControllerType type, int32_t cmd, int32_t param) = 0;
	virtual void OnMmiKeyEvent(MMIControllerType type, std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent>& keyEvent)= 0;
	virtual void OnMmiPointerEvent(MMIControllerType type, std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent>& pointerEvent)= 0;
};

class InputBackController {
public:
	InputBackController();
	~InputBackController();
	bool IsEnable();
	//使用type区分功能使能和开始停止控制
	int32_t Init();
	int32_t Enable();
	int32_t Disable();
	int32_t Release();

	void SetListener(std::weak_ptr<InputBackControllerListener> listener);

	//处理MMI事件，调用InjectPointerEvent将其插入MMI子系统完成反控
	int32_t InjectMMKeyEvent(std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent> keyEvent);
	int32_t InjectMMInputEvent(std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent> pointerEvent);

	//监听来自MMI的事件，调用MMI函数直接注册给子系统
	void OnMmiKeyEvent(std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent> keyEvent);
	void OnMmiPointerEvent(std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent> pointerEvent);

private:
	//MMI监视器句柄
	int32_t mmiHandle_;

	std::mutex mutex_;
	std::atomic<bool> enable_ = false;
	std::weak_ptr<InputBackControllerListener> listener_;

	//MMI设备ID表
	std::vector<int32_t> mmiDevIds_;
	std::map<int32_t, std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::InputDevice>>  mmiIdDevMap_;

	//MMI的客户端
	sptr<OHOS::MMI::IMultimodalInputConnect> mmiProxy_ = nullptr;
};
```
(3) 管理端与sink/source均属于windowMgr模块
```cpp
class InputBackManager ：public HandleEventBase
            	 , public EventEmitter
				 , public InputBackControllerListener
				 , public DelayedSingleton<InputBackManager>
				 , public std::enable_shared_from_this<InputBackManager>{
DECLARE_DELAYED_SINGLETON(InputBackManager);
public:
    //module event/msg process
    int32_t HandleEvent(SharingEvent &event) final;
	//interaction_manager拆包MSG_ID进行分发
	int32_t ForwardDomainMsg(BaseDomainMsg::Ptr &msg);
	//window manager
	int32_t HandleStopCanvas(uint64_t canvasId);
	int32_t HandleStartCanvas(uint64_t canvasId);

    int32_t HandleDestoryCanvas();
	int32_t HandleDelCanvas(const uint64_t canvasId);
	int32_t HandleAddCanvas(int32_t agentId, const CanvasControllerType type, uint64_t canvasId);
	int32_t HandleAddCanvasTmp(int32_t agentId, const CanvasControllerType type, RectBox canvasRect);
	int32_t HandleUpdateCanvas(uint64_t canvasId, Rect remoteMmi, Rect remoteVideo);
	
    //IBctrl manager
	bool    HandleIsEnableIBController();

	int32_t HandleEnableIBController();
	int32_t HandleDisableIBController();
	// impl listeners 
	void OnMmiControllerNotify(const InputBackControllerType type, int32_t cmd, int32_t param) = 0;
	void OnMmiKeyEvent(const InputBackControllerType type, const std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent>& keyEvent)= 0;
	void OnMmiPointerEvent(const InputBackControllerType type, const std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent>& pointerEvent)= 0;
private:
	bool ConvertEventToKeyboard(const SharingEvent &event, std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent>& keyEvent);
	bool ConvertKeyboardToEvent(const std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent>& keyEvent, SharingEvent &event);

	bool ConvertPointerToEvent(const std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent> &pointerEvent, SharingEvent &event);
	bool ConvertEventToPointer(SharingEvent &event, const std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent> &pointerEvent);
private:
    std::shared_ptr<InputBackController::Ptr> ibController_ = nullptr;

	//本机业务agentId与CanvasId的map
	std::map<int32_t, int64_t> localCanvasIdMap_;
	//需要确认远程IDkey格式
	std::map<std::string, int64_t> remoteCanvasIdMap_;
	//本机windowMap, 用于管理本地窗口
	std::map<int64_t, CanvasController::Ptr>  localCanvasMap_;

}
```
(5) 框架接口 包含反控信令/事件传输  (RPC Adapter & RPC msg)
```cpp
//sharing_adapter
struct RectBox {
	using Ptr = std::shared_ptr<RectBox>;

	uint64_t canvasId;
	std::string remoteId; 
	
	Rect remoteMmi;
	Rect remoteVideo;
}

//框架事件
EVENT_INPUTBACK_ENABLE, 		使能反控
EVENT_INPUTBACK_DISABLE,		关闭反控
EVENT_INPUTBACK_CHECK_ENABLE    查询反控开关
EVENT_INPUTBACK_ADD_SOURCECANVAS 主控端插入Canvas
EVENT_INPUTBACK_ADD_SINKCANVAS   被控端插入Canvas
EVENT_INPUTBACK_UPDATE_SOURCECANVAS 主控端更新Canvas
EVENT_INPUTBACK_STATE_UPDATE_SOURCECANVAS 主控端更新Canvas
EVENT_INPUTBACK_STATE_UPDATE_SINKCANVAS   被控端完成更新Canvas
EVENT_INPUTBACK_DEL_CANVAS    删除主被控端canvas
EVENT_INPUTBACK_START_SOURCECANVAS CANVAS的开始/停止事件
EVENT_INPUTBACK_START_SINKCANVAS
EVENT_INPUTBACK_STOP_SOURCECANVAS   
EVENT_INPUTBACK_STOP_SINKCANVAS  
//框架接口
class ISharingAdapter {
	bool IsEnableInputBack();
	//Enable可以重复调用，内部去重
	int32_t EnableInputBack();
	int32_t DisableInputBack();

	//由窗口控制开始和停止状态  主控only
	int32_t StopInputBack(uint64_t canvasId);
	int32_t StartInputBack(std::string remoteId, uint64_t canvasId);
	
	//窗口的增删和设置 由于主控端仅有窗口，Windowtype固定为 CANVAS_WINDOW_SINK，被控端则需要填写类型参数
	int32_t DelCanvas(uint64_t canvasId)
	//临时版本使用surfaceId填充canvasId, 正式版使用windowId或者screenId填充
	int32_t AddInputBackCanvas(int32_t contextId, int32_t agentId, uint64_t canvasId);
	int32_t AddInputBackCanvasTmp(int32_t contextId, int32_t agentId, RectBox canvasRect);
	int32_t AddInputCanvas(int32_t contextId, int32_t agentId, const CanvasControllerType type，uint64_t canvasId);
	//被控端收到主控端由scene发出的domain消息后触发。add后有IB模块自动更新rect到多个主控。
	int32_t AddInputCanvasTmp(int32_t contextId, int32_t agentId, const CanvasControllerType type，RectBox canvasRect);
};


//双向协商控制（允不允许反控由主投端协商时告诉被投端）
//Init 主控->被控，用于主控端向被控端请求反控（只在主控段作为反控发起端时使用）
struct InputBackReq : public BaseDomainMsg {
	uint64_t canvasId;
};

// 被控->主控，向主控端设置被控端参数
struct UpdateCanvasReq : public InputBackReq {
	std::string remoteId;

	Rect mmiRect;
	Rect videoRect;
};
//Start 主控->被控，通知被控端开始进行反控
struct StartInputBackReq : public InputBackReq {
};
//Stop 主控->被控，通知被控端停止进行反控
struct StopInputBackReq : public InputBackReq {
};

//Rsp 双向传输，作为控制指令的应答
struct InputBackRspMsg: public InputBackReq {
	int32_t status = 0;
	int32_t triggerReqId = 0;
};

//MMI event
struct InputBackPointerEventMsg :public InputBackReq {
	int64_t canvasId;
	std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::PointerEvent> pointerEvent;
};

struct InputBackKeyEventMsg :public InputBackReq {
	std::shared_ptr<OHOS::MMI::KeyEvent> KeyEvent;
};


```

### 反控业务基本接口流程
**EnableInputBack**：Scene调用EnableInputBack()接口，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_ENABLE事件发送给InputBackManager，InputManager判断Mmi控制器InputBackController是否已经使能和初始化，如未进行初始化，则创建一个InputBackController实例，调用其Init接口初始化MMIproxy（被控端功能）并注册MMI监听函数（主控端功能），完成后InputBackManager将自身指针作为lister注册给InputBackController，
调用Enable函数，将InputBackController使能置为true。

![](https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/__puml/6070947e737989433a7712a8bb97b7d0.svg#lake_card_-SW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlcjpJbml0XG5JbnB1dEJhY2tDb250cm9sbGVyLT5JbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyOk9LXG5JbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyLT5JbnB1dEJhY2tDb250cm9sbGVyOlNldExpc3RlbmVyXG5JbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyLT5JbnB1dEJhY2tDb250cm9sbGVyOkVuYWJsZVxuSW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlci0-SW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlcjpPS1xuSW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlci0-)**DisableInputBack()：**Scene调用EnableInputBack()接口，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_DISABLE事件发送给InputBackManager；InputBackManager判断Mmi控制器InputBackController是否已经使能和初始化，如果已进行初始化，则调用InputBackController的Disable接口，该接口内首先置使能为false，停止所有事件处理，之后反注册MMI监听函数, 删除MMIproxy，最后InputBackManager删除InputBackController。
![](https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/__puml/a5deea834a6e318df0a9f43488ddaa31.svg#lake_card_-IElucHV0QmFja0NvbnRyb2xsZXI6SGFuZGxlRGlzYWJsZUlCQ29udHJvbGxlclxuYWN0aXZhdGUgSW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlclxuSW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlci0-)
**IsEnableInputBack()**：Scene调用IsEnableInputBack()接口，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_CHECK_ENABLE同步事件发送给InputBackManager，InputBackManager判断InputBackController是否有效或者InputBackController是否已使能，如果InputBackController无效或未使能，则返回false，反之为true；
![](https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/__puml/765ae03071f7fd9cee5010301e3e761d.svg#lake_card_-IElucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXI6RVZFTlRfSU5QVVRCQUNLX0NIRUNLX0VOQUJMRVxuYWN0aXZhdGUgSW5wdXRCYWNrTWFuYWdlclxuZGVhY3RpdmF0ZSBJbnRlcmFjdGlvblxuXG5JbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyIC0-)
**AddInputBackCanvas()**：主控端Scene调用，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_ADD_SOURCECANVAS事件，事件内包含业务agentId/contextId和该业务对应窗口的Rect信息（x,y,w,h），InputBackManager使用前述信息构造CanvasController实例，主控端暂时仅使用Source_Window的窗口类型。主控端Canvas开始状态默认为false;
![](https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/__puml/c9af6a877fa940ff562d8f5973e05086.svg#lake_card_v2=eyJ0eXBlIjoicHVtbCIsImNvZGUiOiJAc3RhcnR1bWxcblxuYXV0b251bWJlclxuXG5hY3RvciBcIuS4u-aOp--IEludGVyYWN0aW9uOiBBZGRJbnB1dEJhY2tDYW52YXNcbmFjdGl2YXRlIEludGVyYWN0aW9uXG5kZWFjdGl2YXRlIFVzZXJcbkludGVyYWN0aW9uIC0-IElucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXI6RVZFTlRfSU5QVVRCQUNLX0FERF9TT1VSQ0VDQU5WQVNcbmFjdGl2YXRlIElucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXJcbmRlYWN0aXZhdGUgSW50ZXJhY3Rpb25cblxuSW5wdXRCYWNrTWFuYWdlciAtPiBDYW52YXNDb250cm9sbGVyOkhhbmRsZUFkZENhbnZhc1RtcFxuYWN0aXZhdGUgQ2FudmFzQ29udHJvbGxlclxuQ2FudmFzQ29udHJvbGxlci0-)**AddInputCanvas()**：被控端Scene调用，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_ADD_SINKCANVAS事件，事件内包含业务agentId/contextId和该业务对应窗口的Rect信息（x,y,w,h），以及被投端的Canvas类型，InputBackManager使用前述信息构造CanvasController实例，被控端可以存在窗口和屏幕两种类型。当该Canvas完成创建之后，InputBackManager将获取Canvas存储的本端Rect信息，构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_STATE_UPDATE_SINKCANVAS事件，通过RPC转化并发送UpdateCanvasReq更新主控端Rect，主控端接收该消息，在InteractionManager转换成框架事件EVENT_INPUTBACK_UPDATE_SOURCECANVAS，发给主控端InputBackManager，其调用HandleUpdateCanvas函数更新业务对应的Canvas信息，随后Canvas内部调用ConvertRelativeRect计算坐标转换系。被控端Canvas开始状态默认为true;
![](https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/__puml/7ca0570a4142b265ff9e4cef6859fd1b.svg#lake_card_v2=eyJ0eXBlIjoicHVtbCIsImNvZGUiOiJAc3RhcnR1bWxcblxuYXV0b251bWJlclxuXG5hY3RvciBcIuiiq-aOp-errzpTY2VuZVwiIGFzIFVzZXJcbnBhcnRpY2lwYW50IFwi6KKr5o6n56uvOkludGVyYWN0aW9uXCIgYXMgSW50ZXJhY3Rpb25cbnBhcnRpY2lwYW50IFwi6KKr5o6n56uvOklucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXJcIiBhcyBJbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyXG5wYXJ0aWNpcGFudCBcIuiiq-aOp-errzpJbnB1dEJhY2tDb250cm9sbGVyXCIgYXMgSW5wdXRCYWNrQ29udHJvbGxlclxucGFydGljaXBhbnQgXCLooqvmjqfnq686Q2FudmFzQ29udHJvbGxlclwiIGFzIENhbnZhc0NvbnRyb2xsZXJcbnBhcnRpY2lwYW50IFwi6KKr5o6n56uvOkRvbWFpbk1hbmFnZXJcIiBhcyBEb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyXG5wYXJ0aWNpcGFudCBcIuS4u-aOp-errzpEb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyXCIgYXMgVXNlcjIgI29yYW5nZVxucGFydGljaXBhbnQgXCLkuLvmjqfnq686SW50ZXJhY3Rpb25NYW5hZ2VyXCIgYXMgSW50ZXJhY3Rpb24yICNvcmFuZ2VcbnBhcnRpY2lwYW50IFwi5Li75o6n56uvOklucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXJcIiBhcyBJbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyMiAjb3JhbmdlXG5wYXJ0aWNpcGFudCBcIuS4u-aOp--IENhbnZhc0NvbnRyb2xsZXI6SGFuZGxlQWRkQ2FudmFzVG1wXG5hY3RpdmF0ZSBDYW52YXNDb250cm9sbGVyXG5DYW52YXNDb250cm9sbGVyLT5DYW52YXNDb250cm9sbGVyOmNyZWF0ZVxuQ2FudmFzQ29udHJvbGxlci0-SW5wdXRCYWNrTWFuYWdlcjpDYW52YXNDb250cm9sbGVyXG5kZWFjdGl2YXRlIENhbnZhc0NvbnRyb2xsZXJcbklucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXItPkRvbWFpbk1hbmFnZXI6Rm9yd2FyZERvbWFpbk1zZ1xuZGVhY3RpdmF0ZSBJbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyXG5kZWFjdGl2YXRlIEludGVyYWN0aW9uXG5hY3RpdmF0ZSBEb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyXG5Eb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyLS0-VXNlcjI6UlBDXG5hY3RpdmF0ZSBVc2VyMlxuZGVhY3RpdmF0ZSBEb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyXG5Vc2VyMi0--)
**DelCanvas():** Scene调用，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_DEL_CANVAS事件，事件携带canvasId, InputBackManager查询该Id的CanvasController是否存在，如不存在则返回错误；如果存在，则先调用Canvas的Stop函数停止对该canvas的事件操作，之后从自身列表直接删除该Canvas。
![](https://cdn.nlark.com/yuque/__puml/6ba244a0ac59753c0bf70d6f2c0fc41d.svg#lake_card_)**StartInputBack() : **主控端Scene调用，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_START_SOURCECANVAS事件，事件携带对端设备ID和本端canvasId。InputBackManager首先判断该canvasId的CanvasController是否存在，如不存在则返回错误；如存在，则先发送通过RPC向被控端发送InputBackReq。 被控端接收到该消息后，转换为EVENT_INPUTBACK_REQ事件，发送给InputBackManager， InputManager判断本机是否使能，如未使能反控功能，则发送RPC消息InputBackRspMsg返回错误。若已使能，发送RPC消息InputBackRspMsg返回可以进行反控的消息; 主控端InputBackManager接收到该消息后，将对应Canvas的开始状态置为true后发送RPC消息
StartInputBackReq，被控端接收到该消息之后，转换为EVENT_INPUTBACK_START_SINKCANVAS事件发送给InputManager模块,如果对应的主控端存在，则调用Canvas的Start。不存在则不进行动作。完成该消息处理之后，被控端回复InputBackRspMsg通知成功。

 **主控端Scene调用，由interaction构造EVENT_INPUTBACK_STOP_SOURCECANVAS事件，事件携带本端canvasId。InputBackManager首先判断该canvasId的CanvasController是否存在，如不存在则返回错误；如存在，则先发送通过RPC向被控端发送StopInputBackReq，控端接收到该消息后，转换为EVENT_INPUTBACK_SINK_STOP事件，发送给InputBackManager，被控端反控模块接收该事件后，查找该主控Id对应的canvas是否存在，如存在则调用该Canvas的Stop停止坐标处理，如果id不存在，通过RPC发送InputBackRspMsg返回错误给主控端。

N0aXZhdGUgRG9tYWluTWFuYWdlclxuRG9tYWluTWFuYWdlci0--SW5wdXRCYWNrTWFuYWdlcjJcbmRlYWN0aXZhdGUgQ2FudmFzQ29udHJvbGxlcjJcbklucHV0QmFja01hbmFnZXIyLT5Eb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyMjpPS1xuZGVhY3RpdmF0ZSBJbnB1dEJhY2tNYW5hZ2VyMlxuRG9tYWluTWFuYWdlcjItLT5Eb21haW5NYW5hZ2VyOlJQQ1xuYWN0aXZhdGUgRG9tYWluTWFuYWdlclxuRG9tYWluTWFuYWdlci0-)**反控消息获取处理流程：**主控端注册一个监听函数处理MMI的Pointer事件，当事件回调触发，从pointer时间中获取时间类型和对应坐标，坐标通过MapCoordinates函数将本机坐标转换为对端的对应坐标，完成处理后，将Pointer事件发送给InputBackController的Listener(InputbackManager), InputbackManager转换为EVENT_INPUTBACK_SOURCE_POINTER事件,通过RPC发送含有该事件的InputBackPointerEventMsg到被控端，被控端将该消息转换为EVENT_INPUTBACK_SINK_POINTER的事件发送到本机InputbackManager，该模块最终调用InjectMMInputEvent函数，通过mmiProxy将事件注册到MMI子系统完成反控。
